## 'Tis the Season for Tootsie Peppermint Pops!


For a limited time, the festive peppermint-flavored pops are back! Just in time to get into the festive spirit!


### Make Your Holidays Extra Minty!


Gluten-free, peanut-free, and more importantly, the perfect stocking stuffer! Tootsie Peppermint Pops are a refreshing twist on the classic Tootsie Pop, now bringing holiday cheer with your favorite snack! Each lick is a journey of sweet, minty goodness that will have you saying “deeeelicious!” Enjoy either with friends, or get a whole bag for yourself!


[Shop Now!](https://shop.tootsie.com/collections/tootsie-pops/products/tootsie-pops-peppermint-9-6-oz-bag)
